hero.headline: Psychiatry Near Kirkwood, Missouri
hero.intro: Kirkwood is far enough from our office — about 18–20 minutes — that most of our Kirkwood patients end up doing the bulk of their appointments by telehealth, with an in-person visit when it's worth the drive. Angela Jones, PMHNP's appointments are virtual by default, which fits that pattern well.

whyLocals.heading: Why Kirkwood Patients Choose Us
whyLocals.paragraph: John Gransbach, DNP treats adolescents and adults, and his doctoral work focused specifically on helping anxious teens reduce suicidal thinking — relevant for Kirkwood families navigating the pressure that comes with competitive school and sports culture. We coordinate psychiatric care with therapy for families who need both, rather than sending you to piece it together with separate, uncoordinated providers.

localFaqs.question: Is telehealth psychiatry available throughout Missouri, not just near your office?
localFaqs.answer: Yes — Angela Jones, PMHNP sees patients by telehealth throughout Missouri, which covers Kirkwood easily. An in-person visit at our office is available whenever you'd prefer one.

localFaqs.question: Can a Kirkwood teen get evaluated for anxiety or ADHD without a referral?
localFaqs.answer: Yes, no referral is needed. John Gransbach, DNP evaluates adolescents directly, and we coordinate with your Kirkwood pediatrician if you'd like us to.

localFaqs.question: What if my Kirkwood teen needs both therapy and medication?
localFaqs.answer: We provide both under one roof and coordinate care between the therapist and psychiatric provider, which matters for teens especially — it means two people on your family's care are actually talking to each other.
